primary_recommendation.selection_basis: Highest target score WITHIN the Pareto frontier (ties broken by the route/round/experiment/candidate composite key ascending, because candidate_id repeats across rounds). No frontier member was removed by this choice.
primary_recommendation.cross_route_comparability_disclaimer: Cross-route target-score ordering is INDICATIVE ONLY. Each route normalizes its soft score against its own executable objective contract; the normalized values are not directly comparable between routes (red line 6). This ranking is used solely to pick the primary recommendation INSIDE the Pareto frontier -- it never removes any solution from the frontier, and every frontier member remains part of the delivered portfolio.

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: A 36-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 stack with optimized individual layer thicknesses can simultaneously suppress transmittance in both 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm bands while maintaining high transmittance in 420-700 nm, with performance improving as thickness optimization progresses through gradient-based tuning.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate (18 Ta2O5 layers, 18 SiO2 layers, 36 total)

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Random thickness initialization across expanded bounds [10,400]nm will escape local optima that trapped quarter-wave initialized designs, enabling discovery of non-intuitive thickness combinations that better separate dual stopbands from the visible passband.

Locking the core resonance layers (indices 2-9) to ±5 nm tolerance while optimizing only the outer cladding layers (indices 0-1 and 10-11) will preserve the phase alignment that produced the round-1 best score of 0.9275, while allowing fine-tuning of input/output coupling to improve dual-stopband suppression without catastrophic degradation.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: 12 finite alternating layers: Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2 on fused silica substrate with air incidence

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: The 0.9506 score from iteration 30 relies on a specific thick-layer resonance feature (~245 nm Ta2O5 at layer 3 position). Preserving this anchor while applying asymmetric ±12% perturbations to flanking layers will reveal whether the solution occupies a robust multi-band plateau or a narrow resonance peak.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: 16 alternating layers: Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2 on fused silica substrate, air incidence
